messages:
elaine: Hey team — Pinnacle Bank just sent their SIG. They want question-by-question evidence for our Hosted API + Dedicated POC. Deadline is Friday. I started a checklist in drive, can we triage who owns what? :calendar:

mike: Thanks, elaine. Do we have a current encryption-at-rest artifact and a short KMS rotation statement? I can link SOC2 summary once redacted.

jess: SOC2 summary: https://redwood.internal/secure/soc2-2025.pdf (sales-only access). For encryption at rest we have an internal runbook but it needs infra confirmation for wording.

ryan: @mike @infra-oncall I can confirm KMS rotation for Hosted — we run automated rotation via KMS policy. Draft snippet for the SIG answer:
```
Rotation: automatic via KMS key policy (30-day rotation for intermediate keys; key material rotation logged).
Audit: rotation events stored in Audit Lake.
```
I'll make a one-paragraph answer.

infra-oncall: Confirmed. For Private deployments customers may bring their own KMS. For Hosted our managed KMS rotates per policy and we record rotation receipts in the audit log. I'll attach the internal note to the drive folder.

jess: Checklist updated in the drive. Also Pinnacle explicitly asked for an architecture diagram showing VPC peering and Dedicated isolation. Elaine — single diagram with callouts or separate diagrams?

elaine: Single diagram with clear callouts for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private please. POC will emphasize Dedicated footprint.

ryan: I'll author a cropped architecture PNG and upload to the drive: https://drive.redwood/pinnacle/sig-assets (will include callouts).

mike: Security asked about pen test cadence + findings. We have an internal pen test 2024 and third-party in 2023. I'll redact and attach summaries and vendor CVs as needed.

sig-bot: New SIG template v1.8 imported into the workspace. Mapping available: q1-q182. Use `/sig fill` to start auto-mapping of fields.

elaine: Quick owners check — who takes q12 (network isolation), q34 (data residency), q77 (third-party assurance)? I'll run the tracker after we assign.

jess: I'll take q12 (network isolation) and q34 (data residency). @ryan can you take q77?

ryan: Taking q77. I'll reference the vendor-assurance packet here: https://confluence.redwood/vend-assurance/pk and include the attestation paragraph.

mike: Pricing note from Pinnacle: does Dedicated POC usage count towards committed usage for discounts? We need a written answer. Elaine, want me to draft?

elaine: Looping in @sophie from Enterprise Sales — Sophie, we need a clarifying line about POC credits and annual commit today.

sophie: On it. I'll confirm whether POC credits can be applied to annual commit and draft the response for the SIG packet.

elaine: Plan: assemble per-question artifacts into a zip and send via secure upload by EOD Thursday. Any blockers?

infra-oncall: No infra blockers. I'll upload KMS rotation receipts + pen-test artifacts by 17:00 today.

mike: I'll redact SOC2 excerpts and prep the pen-test summary by noon tomorrow.

jess: I'll produce the diagram and q12/34 writeups by 15:00 today and push to the drive.

elaine: Thanks everyone — I'll assemble all assets, do a final pass on language, and upload. :thumbsup:

mike: One small follow-up: Pinnacle asked for a CSV mapping question IDs to file names (they prefer one-to-one). I'll generate that after attachments are in place.

elaine: Perfect — add that to the zip manifest.

sig-bot: Reminder: export of SIG must be signed-off by Legal before external upload. Please ping @legal when ready.

elaine: Noted, will ping Legal once we have final bundle.

sophie: I'll confirm the POC/commit language within an hour and paste it here for inclusion.

elaine: Awesome — thanks team, closing this thread after upload.
